## Walkthrough

Replaces the old PVM interpreter interface with Typeberry's new Interpreter in the fuzzer. Refactors execution from iterative stepping to a single runProgram call. Updates all VM API accessors (registers, gas, program counter). Changes TypeScript module resolution strategy to bundler.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **VM API Migration** <br> `bin/fuzz.ts` | Swaps `pvm_interpreter.DebuggerAdapter` for `@typeberry/lib/pvm-interpreter`'s `Interpreter`. Replaces `vm.reset()` with `vm.resetGeneric()` using `tryAsGas()`. Changes stepping loop to single `vm.runProgram()` call. Introduces `decodeRegistersFromTypeberry()` helper to read registers via `vm.registers.getU64()`. Updates gas/PC accessors: `vm.getGasLeft()` → `vm.gas.get()`, `vm.getProgramCounter()` → `vm.getPC()`. |
| **Configuration** <br> `tsconfig.json` | Changes `moduleResolution` from `"node"` to `"bundler"`. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- **tomusdrw/anan-as#93**: Modifies bin/fuzz.ts to update VM interface interactions and register/gas API calls.
- **tomusdrw/anan-as#83**: Migrates fuzz CLI from old Pvm API to new interpreter/VM API with updated gas/pc/register accessors.
- **tomusdrw/anan-as#129**: Updates bin/fuzz.ts to adopt Typeberry pvm_interpreter and changes VM register decoding approach.
